summary: Comprehensive backend (pytest, 17 tests) and frontend (Playwright, 11 flows) testing of Workforce HRMS. All 17 backend tests and all 11 frontend flows passed against the deployed preview URL. Auth (login/register/me/logout) with httpOnly cookies, role enforcement (admin/manager/employee), departments/employees CRUD, attendance check-in/out, leave apply/approve, dashboard stats, landing/login/register/dashboard/employees/departments/attendance/leaves/profile pages and logout redirect all verified.

minor.issue: When CORS_ORIGINS="*" the server starts with allow_credentials=False. In production behind ingress this is same-origin so it works, but if a tester sets CORS_ORIGINS="*" and expects cross-origin cookie auth, it will silently fail. Recommend defaulting to explicit origins.
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting on /api/auth/login (playbook recommends lockout after 5 fails).
secure=False on Set-Cookie. Acceptable for preview, but in production (HTTPS) cookies should be Secure + SameSite=None when serving on a different subdomain than the API.
Refresh token is issued but no /auth/refresh endpoint exists; access token will simply expire after 8h with no recovery path.

issues: Page renders as expected with hero, modules, CTA. No contrast/spacing issues observed in initial review.

action_items: (Optional) Add /api/auth/refresh endpoint that consumes the refresh_token cookie and re-issues a new access_token, otherwise the long-lived refresh cookie is unused.
(Optional) Add brute-force lockout / rate limiting on login per playbook.
(Optional) Tighten CORS default away from "*" so credentialed cross-origin requests work without manual env tweaking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 600-line file housing models, routes, and seed logic. Acceptable for an MVP but should be split into routers (auth, employees, departments, attendance, leaves, dashboard) and a models module before adding more features.
MongoDB ObjectId is correctly excluded via {"_id": 0} projections everywhere reviewed.
Pydantic validation in place via EmailStr / Literal / Field; input is not blindly trusted.
Frontend axios is configured with withCredentials: true and uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — env-driven and correct.
data-testid attributes are present on all critical interactive elements (login, dashboard stat cards, employees, departments, leaves).
test_credentials: admin@workforce.com/admin123, manager@workforce.com/manager123, fresh employee created via /register during tests
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed departments, employees, leaves and a fresh TEST_emp_* user via /register. No production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and run cleanly with `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. They register a fresh employee per session for role-based tests. Cookies (access_token, refresh_token) are httpOnly and properly set on login/register, cleared on logout. CORS works because frontend and backend share the same preview origin. Frontend Playwright flows validated landing, admin login, dashboard stats (4 cards), employees page, department creation, attendance, leaves, profile, logout, bad-login error, and manager view of leaves.
rca of the issue: No bugs found; nothing to RCA.
